basic_details.job_title: Anna University Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Chemistry, Anna University (University College of Engineering, CEG Campus), Chennai, has invited applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in a 36-month research project funded by the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), HRDG, EMR-II, New Delhi. The post is temporary and purely on a contractual basis, with a fellowship of Rs. 37000/- p.m. Applicants need an MS/M.Sc./B.E/B.Tech or equivalent degree with 55% marks and a pass in NET/GATE. Applications in the enclosed format must be sent by registered post and to the mail ID on or before 11.12.2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit for the JRF post is 28 years. The notice does not print a date for counting age. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to scheduled castes/tribes/OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

qualification.details: M.Sc. in Chemistry (all specializations)/ Nanoscience/ Materials Science / Environmental Science and any related specialisation.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the enclosed format (Annexure-1 Application Form), which asks for personal details, education background from matriculation onward, experience, area of expertise in 50 words, awards or patents, and a signed declaration.
Affix a recent passport size photo on the form.
Attach a copy of degree certificates and other relevant documents. The form also asks for scanned copies of qualifying degree certificates and mark sheets, and of experience certificates.
Send the application through registered post to Dr. Keerthi, Assistant Professor (Sr.Gr.), Department of Chemistry, CEG Campus, Anna University, Chennai -600025.
Also send it to the mail ID, [email protected] / [email protected], on or before 11.12.2026. The phone number given is 9940133080.
Quote Appln: 70(0094)/26/EMR-II in the top left corner of the envelope.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be provided for candidates attending the interview. The post is only a temporary position; the declaration in the application form states that the applicant is aware of this. If any discrepancy is found at any stage, Anna University, Chennai, shall cancel the application / selection, as stated in the declaration. Applications must be in the given format with a copy of degree certificates and other relevant documents.

content_sections.heading: Anna University Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Anna University: Chennai, University College of Engineering (CEG Campus), Chennai
Solar Assisted Photo-Electro-Fenton/E1ectro-Fenton Integrated Membrane Reactor for Tannery Wastewater
Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), Human Resources Development Group (HRDG), EMR-II, New Delhi
Rs. 37000/- p.m.; 42000/- p.m. in 3rd year upon upgradation

content_sections.heading: About Anna University CEG Campus
content_sections.text: Anna University: Chennai, University College of Engineering (CEG Campus), is located at Chennai - 600025. The project is led by Dr. Keerthi, Assistant Professor (Sr.Gr.), Department of Chemistry. The Co-Principal Investigator is Dr. Shubra Singh, Assistant Professor, Crystal Growth Centre, Anna University. The CSIR Host Investigator is Dr. U Sathya, Senior Scientist, Environmental Engineering Dept., CSIR-Central Leather Research Institute, Chennai - 600020.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites interested and motivated candidates for the single JRF post. M.Sc. in Chemistry (all specializations)/ Nanoscience/ Materials Science / Environmental Science and any related specialisation. The age limit for the JRF post is 28 years. The notice does not print a date for counting age. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to scheduled castes/tribes/OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: MS/M.Sc./B. E/B. Tech. or equivalent degree, with 55% marks and passing of NET /GATE test.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is printed as: Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Rs. 37000/- p.m., in First & Second years 42000/- p.m., in 3rd upon upgradation. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances. The appointment is for a temporary period, purely on contractual basis, in a time bound research project. The project tenure is 36 months. The initial appointment will be made for six months, and an extension will be based on the candidate's performance.

content_sections.heading: Anna University Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: To execute the research work detailed in the entitled project Compilation of the results Report preparation

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Anna University Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the enclosed format (Annexure-1 Application Form), which asks for personal details, education background from matriculation onward, experience, area of expertise in 50 words, awards or patents, and a signed declaration. Affix a recent passport size photo on the form. Attach a copy of degree certificates and other relevant documents. The form also asks for scanned copies of qualifying degree certificates and mark sheets, and of experience certificates. Send the application through registered post to Dr. Keerthi, Assistant Professor (Sr.Gr.), Department of Chemistry, CEG Campus, Anna University, Chennai -600025. Also send it to the mail ID, [email protected] / [email protected] , on or before 11.12.2026. The phone number given is 9940133080. Quote Appln: 70(0094)/26/EMR-II in the top left corner of the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The actual date and time of the interview will be intimated only to shortlisted candidates in due course by e-mail only. Shortlisted candidates should appear for the interview with their original certificates. The selection process is strictly as per the University guidelines. The notice does not give an interview date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be provided for candidates attending the interview. The post is only a temporary position; the declaration in the application form states that the applicant is aware of this. If any discrepancy is found at any stage, Anna University, Chennai, shall cancel the application / selection, as stated in the declaration. Applications must be in the given format with a copy of degree certificates and other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there at Anna University CEG Campus?
faq.answer: The notice announces 01 vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in the CSIR-funded project at the Department of Chemistry, Anna University, CEG Campus, Chennai.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Anna University JRF 2026?
faq.answer: The application must be sent through registered post and to the mail ID on or before 11.12.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Anna University JRF?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is an MS/M.Sc./B.E/B.Tech or equivalent degree with 55% marks and passing of NET/GATE test. An M.Sc. in Chemistry, Nanoscience, Materials Science, Environmental Science or a related specialisation is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Anna University JRF?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years. It is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the Anna University JRF post?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 37000/- p.m. in the first and second years, and 42000/- p.m. in the 3rd year upon upgradation, as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Anna University JRF post?
faq.answer: Send the application in the enclosed Annexure-1 format with a copy of degree certificates and other relevant documents to Dr. Keerthi, Department of Chemistry, CEG Campus, Anna University, Chennai -600025 by registered post, and also to the mail ID given in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, and the date and time will be sent by e-mail only. Shortlisted candidates must bring original certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Anna University JRF job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is temporary, purely on a contractual basis, in a time bound research project with a tenure of 36 months. The initial appointment is for six months, and an extension will be based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for candidates attending the interview.
